purpose: Evaluate the incremental effect of refreshed versus frozen outcome predictions in repeated candidate-acceptance gates on real chronological recommendation logs.
not_tested: M0 versus M1 versus FULL monitoring
individual ground-truth effects or oracle regret

dataset.name: ZOZO Open Bandit Dataset
dataset.citation: Saito, Aihara, Matsutani and Narita. Open Bandit Dataset and Pipeline: Towards Realistic and Reproducible Off-Policy Evaluation. NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks, 2021.

prior_exposure.pilot_result: Both gates rejected the one development candidate; selected policies were identical. DR and IPS ranked initial and candidate policies differently in subsequent development data.

daily_schedule_UTC.candidate_training: 00:00 inclusive to 12:00 exclusive on the same date; BTS source only
daily_schedule_UTC.gate_check: 12:00 inclusive to 18:00 exclusive on the same date; BTS source only
daily_schedule_UTC.subsequent_evaluation: 18:00 inclusive to 24:00 exclusive on the same date; primary BTS and secondary Random analysed separately

model.reference: Reuse run_gate_pilot.py fit_model, feature_records and predict_all with unchanged model family, features, scaling, regularization and seed.
model.policy: argmax predicted click probability; lowest item_id breaks ties

gates.shared_rule: Paired doubly robust candidate-minus-current-incumbent mean minus 1.96 row standard errors must be strictly positive. This pointwise heuristic is not a valid sequential-safety certificate.
gates.frozen: Use the single outcome model trained on the two initial development days for every gate score.
gates.refreshed: Use that dates candidate outcome model, trained before the gate window, for gate scores.
gates.zero_matching_rows_for_either_compared_p: For each gate independently, reject if either policy in that gates own comparison has zero matching logged rows; record the reason. Apply the same check to both gates. This fail-closed check is an addition to the pilot and must be disclosed.
gates.convergence_or_invalid_input_failure: Stop and preserve incomplete run. Do not silently retune or omit a date.

evaluation.common_outcome_model: The candidate outcome model trained that morning, fixed before the gate and evaluation windows; shared across all evaluated policies.
evaluation.primary_contrast: Equal-weight average across five dates of the within-date DR mean(refreshed_gate_path minus frozen_gate_path) on subsequent BTS evaluation records. Positive favours refreshing.
secondary_contrasts: Same paired contrast using IPS on BTS records
Same DR and IPS paired contrasts using Random records
Each gate path versus initial_no_update, always_update_current_candidate and uniform_over_34_products, reported as secondary with no unadjusted significance claims
evaluation.identical_selected_policies: Report identical decisions and exact score cancellation. A zero interval does not establish population equivalence.

uncertainty_and_diagnostics.row_SEs: Descriptive only; ignore repeat-user/time dependence. Not primary inferential evidence.

exploratory_bootstrap.method: Resample nonempty contiguous 30-minute blocks within each date using common paired block draws; recompute each dates row mean and then average the five date means equally.
exploratory_bootstrap.limitations: Conditions on fitted/selected policy paths and observed five dates. Does not capture full retraining/selection uncertainty, all temporal dependence or repeat-user clustering. Not a population-level confidence guarantee.

uncertainty_and_diagnostics.few_clicks_or_estimator_disagreement: Report as limited or inconclusive evidence; do not interpret non-significance as equivalence.

execution_and_reporting.contribution_scope: A short exploratory real-data gate case study supplementing, not replacing, the controlled simulation evidence.
